entities.summary: Zulfiya Isroilova, known by her pen name Zulfiya was a Soviet and Uzbek writer. She repeatedly was a leader or chief editor for various media, participating in Soviet delegations to various conferences. The Uzbek National Award for Women was created and named after her.
